title: Sparkly violin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='wood' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8a05c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a85a28'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='woodDark' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c87838'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7a3a14'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Violin body -->
  <path d='M50 44 C40 42 34 48 34 55 C34 61 39 64 44 65 C40 68 37 72 38 77 C39 84 45 88 50 88 C55 88 61 84 62 77 C63 72 60 68 56 65 C61 64 66 61 66 55 C66 48 60 42 50 44 Z' fill='url(#wood)' stroke='#f2c48a' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- Waist shading for clarity -->
  <path d='M44 65 C46 67 54 67 56 65' fill='none' stroke='#f2c48a' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- F-holes -->
  <path d='M43 54 C41 58 43 62 44 64' fill='none' stroke='#4a1e08' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M57 54 C59 58 57 62 56 64' fill='none' stroke='#4a1e08' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Bridge -->
  <path d='M45 63 L55 63 L53 60 L47 60 Z' fill='#6b3010' stroke='#f2c48a' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- Tailpiece -->
  <path d='M47 75 L53 75 L52 86 L48 86 Z' fill='#5a2808' stroke='#f2c48a' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='47.5' y='22' width='5' height='24' rx='1.5' fill='url(#woodDark)' stroke='#f2c48a' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- Fingerboard -->
  <rect x='48' y='24' width='4' height='18' fill='#2a1206'/>

  <!-- Strings -->
  <line x1='48.8' y1='24' x2='49' y2='84' stroke='#fff4d8' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='24' x2='50' y2='85' stroke='#fff4d8' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <line x1='51.2' y1='24' x2='51' y2='84' stroke='#fff4d8' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='24' x2='52' y2='83' stroke='#fff4d8' stroke-width='0.4'/>

  <!-- Scroll / pegbox -->
  <path d='M47.5 22 L47.5 15 C47.5 11 50 9 53 11 C56 13 55 17 52 17' fill='url(#woodDark)' stroke='#f2c48a' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Pegs -->
  <line x1='46' y1='14' x2='43' y2='13' stroke='#3a1a06' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='16' x2='57' y2='17' stroke='#3a1a06' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Chinrest hint -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='78' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#3a1a06' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M18 26 L18 32 M15 29 L21 29' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.6'/>
    <path d='M82 20 L82 25 M79.5 22.5 L84.5 22.5' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.4'/>
    <path d='M86 58 L86 64 M83 61 L89 61' stroke='#fff3a0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <path d='M14 62 L14 66 M12 64 L16 64' stroke='#fff3a0' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <path d='M22 84 L22 88 M20 86 L24 86' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <path d='M78 82 L78 87 M75.5 84.5 L80.5 84.5' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#fffbe0'>
    <circle cx='24' cy='42' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='40' r='1.3'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='14' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='14' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='76' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='44' r='1'/>
  </g>
</svg>
